lines: We walked to the furthest corner of the beach to avoid the public's gaze.
There was a rocky stretch beyond this point, and apparently guests also hardly ever swam here.
Aina and I sat in the shade of a rock and revealed our circumstances to one another.
...So I came here on an undercover investigation by request of the military.
I stepped out onto the beach, and that's when I had that situation.
Aina told me that she was a freelance demon hunter who was working with the UFS,
and her primary duty was fighting demons, but she'd happened to have a membership here, and so had received a request from the military to investigate.
I see... So even the UFS is having problems with people going missing here.
But you must be a wellborn lady from quite a family to have a membership here, yeah?
Huh? Um... Well, yeah, it's a bit of this and that.
Aina cast her eye downward, seeming to have difficulty speaking.
B-But ya got a membership too, right? Those Taimanin must be makin' bank!
No, I just happened to inherit mine. I've got so little money that it's sad.
Well, in actuality, my family seemed to be quite rich, but I just couldn't use that money freely.
But about that, this is just a cheery resort.
Nothin' really suspicious besides how annoyin' those skirt-chasing assholes were, right?
Really? Because I feel like something's a little off.
It was a strange feeling I'd had since a while back. I decided to try telling Aina about it.
Yeah... For example, how this place is jam-packed with beautiful women.
I mean, even though it's a luxury resort, normally there'd be all kinds of woman, regardless of how they look, yeah?
And yet I've seen nothing but women who look like celebrities and models for a while now. And not just their faces, but their bodies are also outstanding.
I can only find that stra-... Hm? What's wrong?
I thought I had made a pretty astute observation, truth be told. With that thought in mind, I looked to the side, to see Aina staring at me with a vacant, dumbfounded expression.
That's the only thing ya were lookin' at!!? Wahahahaha!!!
No sooner had Aina blinked a few times than she burst out laughing.
No, that's not... I'm being serious here!
I see, I see! Now I know yer a closet perv! Hee-heeee-hahahaha!
Aina was just rolling with laughter, even to the point of shedding tears.
Well, let's just investigate a little more. I won't get hit on if yer here, so I should be able to make some progress... Ahhh, that was too funny.
Aina walked toward the beach as her shoulders continued shaking with laughter.
(Dammit! That was a totally serious observation!)
With the burden of that misunderstanding on my back, I followed after Aina.
Welcome, welcome! How about some delicious shaved ice!
Shaved ice, 1,000 yen for one cup! ...Boo-hoo-hoo, why am I doing a job like this...
A Succubus was begrudgingly selling shaved ice in a corner of the swimming area. It was Lilim.
Hey, Lilim! The shaved ice is 500 yen, isn't it?
Are you trying to raise the price on your own so you can swipe the difference!?
You thought I wouldn't find out? Jeez... Now, do your job seriously.
The ever-serious Succubus scolding Lilim was Metier.
Mireille told us that depending on how well we work, she'd forgive us for what we did and let us do Succubus work again.
She cannot be serious?! You think I can just keep working in a place as hot as this!?
Lilim gave the cloth of the shaved ice stand a couple of firm smacksー
ーand when she did, giant insects emerged and attacked Metier in unison.
Agh! Come on, Lilim! ーAiee!! Stop it! I said stop iiit!!
Aren't those Devildomian Wasps? I've got a bad feeling about this already.
But why would they be here on a bright, sunny beach like this...?
Noooo～! Get them off～!!! I hate bugs～!
Fuma, what're ya starin' for!? Let's just go help 'er!
